items.title: JAFF Market Opens Third Edition With Call to Measure Indonesian Cinema’s Growth by Quality, Not Just Volume
items.title_zh: JAFF市场第三届开幕，呼吁通过质量而非数量来衡量印尼电影的增长
items.summary: JAFF Market, which organizers bill as Indonesia’s biggest film market, opened its third edition at the Jogja Expo Center in Yogyakarta with market director Linda Gozali urging the local industry to judge its growth on quality as well as scale.
items.summary_zh: JAFF 市场被组织者称为印度尼西亚最大的电影市场，第三届 JAFF 市场在日惹日惹博览中心开幕，市场总监琳达·戈扎利 (Linda Gozali) 敦促当地电影业根据质量和规模来判断其增长。

items.title: Anurag Kashyap, Ranjan Singh Back Haryana-Rooted Short ‘The Melody of Destiny’ as Executive Producers (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: 阿努拉格·卡什亚普 (Anurag Kashyap) 和兰詹·辛格 (Ranjan Singh) 回归哈里亚纳邦短片《命运的旋律》担任执行制片人（独家）
items.summary: Indian auteur Anurag Kashyap (“Gangs of Wasseypur”) and producer Ranjan Singh have boarded “The Melody of Destiny,” a short film rooted in the northern Indian state of Haryana, as presenters and executive producers, backing the film on the festival circuit.
items.summary_zh: 印度导演阿努拉格·卡什亚普（《瓦西布尔黑帮》）和制片人兰詹·辛格作为演示者和执行制片人，以演示者和执行制片人的身份登上了一部源自印度北部哈里亚纳邦的短片《命运的旋律》，支持该影片在电影节上巡回放映。

items.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power a day after US slammed with Thanksgiving storms
items.title_zh: 美国遭受感恩节风暴袭击后一天仍有数十万人断电
items.summary: Pennsylvania and neighbouring states remained badly affected on Friday after both coasts were lashed with wind and rain.
items.summary_zh: 周五，宾夕法尼亚州和邻近各州的海岸都遭受了风雨袭击，仍然受到严重影响。

items.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
items.title_zh: 载有 7,000 吨柴油的倾覆油轮将从伊维萨岛拖走
items.summary: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.
items.summary_zh: 人们担心伊维萨岛会发生重大石油泄漏，但该船的油箱到目前为止完好无损。

items.title: The US army just detonated a poison bomb over Iowa | Steven Donziger
items.title_zh: 美军刚刚在爱荷华州上空引爆了一枚毒弹 |史蒂文·唐齐格
items.summary: The shocking situation in Iowa is a metaphor for much of what is wrong with the United States There’s no way to hide it: the US government just deliberately detonated a poison bomb of lead azide over the state of Iowa when a totally safe alternative was available.
items.summary_zh: 爱荷华州令人震惊的局势隐喻了美国的大部分问题。没有办法隐藏这一点：美国政府只是在有完全安全的替代方案存在的情况下故意在爱荷华州引爆了叠氮化铅毒弹。

items.title: New satellite data shows how fast some African cities are sinking
items.title_zh: 新的卫星数据显示一些非洲城市下沉的速度有多快
items.summary: Cities including Lagos and Alexandria are sinking faster than previously thought, a new study shows.
items.summary_zh: 一项新的研究显示，拉各斯和亚历山大等城市的下沉速度比之前想象的要快。

items.title: Jensen Huang's return did little to ease AI jitters. We used the weakness to buy
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋的回归并没有缓解人工智能的紧​​张情绪。我们利用弱点买入
items.summary: Jensen Huang's return sparked a fleeting AI rally, but persistent market volatility gave us another opportunity to put cash to work.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋的回归引发了短暂的人工智能反弹，但持续的市场波动给了我们另一个投入现金的机会。

items.title: SpaceX shares jump over 4% amid tech rally and after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations
items.title_zh: 在科技股上涨以及马斯克表示将扩大特朗普账户股票捐赠之后，SpaceX 股价上涨超过 4%
items.summary: SpaceX shares jumped in trading Friday after Elon Musk said on X that he would donate shares to American children every year.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 X 上表示，他每年都会向美国儿童捐赠股票，之后 SpaceX 股价周五上涨。

items.title: It’s not just you: Durable goods are getting less reliable, from sputtering cars to glitching smart TVs
items.title_zh: 不仅仅是你：耐用品的可靠性越来越低，从破旧的汽车到出现故障的智能电视
items.summary: A wide swath of consumer products are becoming less reliable and durable, even as their prices rise, research shows.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，尽管价格上涨，大量消费品的可靠性和耐用性却在下降。

items.title: University's £15m savings could be felt 'beyond the campus', union warns
items.title_zh: 工会警告说，大学1500万英镑的节省可能会在“校园之外”感受到
items.summary: Bangor University has announced savings of "at least 15m" would be made through voluntary redundancies.
items.summary_zh: 班戈大学宣布通过自愿裁员节省“至少 1500 万”。
